Supreme Court Halts Action Against SASTRA University in Land Dispute

The Supreme Court has issued an order preventing Tamil Nadu government authorities from taking coercive action against SASTRA University concerning a land dispute. The court's directive halts any immediate enforcement measures related to the ongoing disagreement over the university's land.
